name: Fullscreen Article Carousel
author: charliezhao

sections.description:
Fullscreen Article Carousel transforms your WordPress site into an immersive reading sanctuary. With a single click, readers enter a distraction-free fullscreen mode with smooth carousel navigation between articles.

Features:

  • Immersive Reading – Fullscreen mode hides distractions, letting readers focus on content
  • Elegant Navigation – Smooth carousel with keyboard and touch support
  • Literary Magazine Aesthetic – Carefully crafted typography and spacing for comfortable reading
  • Category Filtering – Automatically shows relevant articles based on current page context
  • Performance Optimized – Lazy loading images and background preloading
  • Fully Responsive – Works beautifully on desktop and mobile devices
  • Internationalized – Ready for translation

Design Philosophy:

Inspired by the aesthetics of literary magazines like The New Yorker and the immersive reading experience of Medium. Deep dark backgrounds, elegant serif typography, generous whitespace, and subtle gold accents create an atmosphere where content truly shines.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the fullscreen-article-carousel folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. No additional configuration required – the fullscreen button appears automatically

Requirements:

  • WordPress 5.6 or higher
  • REST API must be enabled (enabled by default in WordPress 4.7+)
sections.faq:
How do I use it?

Once activated, a floating fullscreen button appears in the top-right corner of your site. Click it to enter immersive reading mode.

Does it work with custom post types?

Currently supports standard WordPress posts. Custom post type support can be added with customization.

Can I customize the colors?

Yes, all colors are defined as CSS custom properties in the stylesheet.
